verdict.rationale: AngelList documents some fixed event-driven automations: employees are automatically terminated when they are terminated in a connected HRIS or payroll system, and cap tables update automatically on grant signing. Board-pre-approved Equity Blocks act as a standing approval rule for standard grants. None of this is a user-defined rule engine, though: the triggers and actions are built in, not configured by the user. missing for 10: user-configurable trigger/condition/action rules, general event or webhook triggers, any automation API (OpenAPI probe found nothing), independent corroboration.
